language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon starts on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot aligns its gripper, closes around the handle (frames 105–114, wrist_image), and lifts and transports the spoon toward the open drawer (frames 120–183, image and left_ego_image). It releases the spoon into the drawer at frames 185–190; the spoon remains resting inside while the empty gripper withdraws through frame 202 (image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unintended object displacement is visibly established.
